section_summary.extract_value: Study 1 was designed to identify exercise regulations most strongly associated with body image and appearance goals for exercise, examining shared variance among these three constructs. The study specifically investigates how introjected and external regulations may link appearance goals to body image, particularly in women, using Self-Determination Theory as a theoretical framework. This cross-sectional study represents an initial exploratory stage in understanding the pathways between these constructs.
